Composition & Indication

Finasteride 5mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Proscar®) contains Finasteride 5 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 5mg strength. The standard indication is the management of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Finasteride 5mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use.
